source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Digoxin immune Fab (DigiFab), which binds circulating digoxin during severe toxicity","B":"Protamine sulfate injection, which neutralizes unfractionated heparin anticoagulant activity","C":"Phytonadione (vitamin K1), which reverses vitamin K antagonist anticoagulant effects","D":"Flumazenil injection, which reverses selected benzodiazepine sedative medication effects"}}
source_row.rationale: Digoxin immune Fab binds digoxin and is indicated for life-threatening or potentially life-threatening digoxin toxicity, including serious ventricular arrhythmias. The other agents reverse different drug classes.
source_row.source_detail: Indications and Usage: treatment of life-threatening or potentially life-threatening digoxin toxicity, including severe ventricular arrhythmias and other specified manifestations.
source_row.source_name: DailyMed — DIGIFAB (digoxin immune Fab) prescribing information
source_row.stem: A client has severe digoxin toxicity with a life-threatening ventricular arrhythmia. Which treatment should the nurse anticipate?
